intent: Practice skip counting by 5s to connect clock numbers to elapsed minutes

data.title: Time Traveler's Number Line
data.description: Learn how to read and write time to the nearest five minutes by jumping along a 60-minute number line.

challenges.instruction: Place your finger on 36 minutes, and make a single jump forward by 3 minutes to find the new time.
challenges.hint: Start at 36 and count 3 hops to the right on the number line.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 26 on the number line. Make a jump forward by 2.
challenges.hint: Count 2 hops to the right from 26 to find your new spot.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 51 and make a jump of 2 spaces to the right.
challenges.hint: Count 2 hops to the right from 51.

challenges.instruction: Place your finger on 5 on the number line and make a jump of 10 to the right.
challenges.hint: Count 10 hops to the right from 5 to find where you land.

judgement.reasoning: The obstacle is confusing clock face numerals with minute values (e.g., reading 4 as 4 minutes instead of 20 minutes). The generator was asked to practice skip-counting by 5s to connect clock numbers to minutes, but instead generated random addition jumps on a number line (e.g., 36 + 3, 26 + 2, 51 + 2) which completely miss skip-counting by 5s or connecting clock numbers to minute values.
judgement.verdict: A teacher would not use this detour because it practices arbitrary single-digit addition jumps rather than skip-counting by 5s to understand clock minute markings.
